function.description: Query the Windows Security event log on the domain controller. Returns matching event records (id, time, account, detail).
function.name: query_windows_events

event_ids.description: Event IDs to fetch, e.g. [4769, 4768, 4662]. Omit to fetch recent security events broadly.

function.description: Run a free-form SPL (Search Processing Language) query against the Splunk SIEM. Use this to search for patterns, correlate events, or investigate anomalies. Returns matching events with timestamps.
function.name: query_splunk

spl_query.description: SPL search query, e.g. 'index=* sourcetype=* EventCode=4769'

time_range.description: Time range for the search, e.g. '15m', '1h', '24h'

function.description: Query web server access logs from the target environment. Returns HTTP requests with timestamps, source IPs, URLs, and response codes.
function.name: query_web_logs

function.description: Query network flow data or connection logs. Shows source/destination IPs, ports, protocols, and connection counts. Use to identify lateral movement or unusual traffic patterns.
function.name: query_network_traffic

function.description: Report a confirmed detection of an adversary technique. Call once per distinct technique observed in the telemetry.
function.name: report_detection

technique_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID, e.g. T1558.003

function.description: Recommend a containment action for a detected technique.
function.name: recommend_containment
